orphan_safe.title: Orphaned entity: {entity_id}
orphan_safe.description: This entity from the '{platform}' platform is orphaned (its source integration or config is gone) and its entity_id is not currently used by anything live. Click Fix to remove it from the registry.

confirm.title: Remove orphaned entity?
confirm.description: Remove {entity_id} (registry id: {registry_id}) from the entity registry? This only removes the registry entry, not any historical state/statistics data.

abort.entity_now_live: Aborted: {entity_id} has become a live entity since the last scan. Run a new scan.

orphan_dangerous.title: Orphaned entity (name reused - manual action needed): {entity_id}
orphan_dangerous.description: An orphaned registry entry (registry id: {registry_id}) shares its entity_id with a currently LIVE entity. This cannot be auto-fixed for safety. If you want to remove only the orphaned entry, call the safe_orphan_cleaner.remove service with registry_ids: ['{registry_id}'] - never remove by entity_id in this case.
